item "notes" are often available and worth keeping. webERP has no item
notes feature; today people put such text in the item's long description.

Add the option to store zero to many notes about a stock item: a way to
add, view, edit and delete an item's notes, reachable from the item's page,
and a way to bring notes in when items are imported.

//
//     SELECT 
//         TABLE_NAME AS 'Referencing Table', 
//         COLUMN_NAME AS 'Foreign Key Column', 
//         CONSTRAINT_NAME AS 'Constraint Name'
//     FROM 
//         information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE
//     WHERE 
//         REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME = 'stockmaster' 
//         AND REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME = 'stockid'
//         AND TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE(); -- Limits results to your current webERP database
//
//   +-----------------------------+--------------------+------------------------------------+
//   | Referencing Table           | Foreign Key Column | Constraint Name                    |
//   +-----------------------------+--------------------+------------------------------------+
//   | bom                         | parent             | bom_ibfk_1                         |
//   | bom                         | component          | bom_ibfk_2                         |
//   | contractbom                 | stockid            | contractbom_ibfk_3                 |

//   | stockcounts                 | stockid            | stockcounts_ibfk_1                 |
//   | stockitemproperties         | stockid            | stockitemproperties_ibfk_1         |

Item notes are added: a new notes page reached from the item's page, and an optional notes column in the stock import. I haven't run any of it (there was nothing to run against), and I only checked it by reading the code.

**What changed**
- **Database:** `sql/updates/44.php` creates a `stockitemnotes` table (note id, stock id, text, who created it, when). It also registers the new `StockNotes.php` script at security level 2. A fresh install picks the table up by running the update.
- **Notes page:** `StockNotes.php` lists an item's notes and lets you add, edit and delete them. It refuses items that don't exist, and delete asks for confirmation.
- **Item page:** `SelectProduct.php` has a new "Maintain Item Notes" link in the item's maintenance links.
- **Deleting an item:** `Stocks.php` now deletes the item's notes first. Otherwise the foreign key would block deleting any item that has notes.
- **Import:** `Z_ImportStocks.php` accepts an optional 19th column, `Notes`.
  - A cell can hold several notes separated by `||`.
  - A blank cell means no notes.
  - Existing 18-column files still import as before.
  - Notes go in inside the same transaction, so a failed row rolls them back too.

**Behaviour to know about**
- Notes are saved HTML-escaped, the same way other text fields are stored. The import does the same, so imported and typed notes look alike.
- The `||` separator means a single imported note can't contain `||` itself.
- The import's template download still lists only the column headings, as it did before, so it now shows `Notes` as the last heading.
- I left the existing import's unescaped item-field inserts alone. They are a separate, pre-existing issue, and only the new notes insert is escaped.
- I didn't touch Clone Item, so cloning an item doesn't copy its notes. Say if you want that.
